question: Let \(A,B\) be real numbers both greater than 0. The graph of the function \(f(x)=Bx^3+2Ax+A\sin(2x)\) passes through the two points \(P=(-1,2)\) and \(Q=(0,1)\).

options.A: finitely many values of \(A\) and infinitely many values of \(B\);
options.B: infinitely many values of \(A\) and infinitely many values of \(B\);
